name: Clipboard
description: Copy and paste programmatically: read, write, transform, and manage the macOS system clipboard, and copy the current selection out of the frontmost app with ⌘C. Supports plain text, HTML, RTF, images, file paths, and clipboard history. Copying the selection needs Accessibility permission — macOS asks on first use.
summary: Read, write and transform the macOS clipboard, and copy the current selection.
